title: Deployment rollout not progressing — shipping service (ImagePullBackOff, revision 8)
description: The shipping deployment in rlvr-target started rolling revision 8 at 19:34, which set the container image to rlvr/shipping:v99-nonexistent. The new ReplicaSet shipping-7d9c4b6f88 cannot pull that image (ErrImagePull/ImagePullBackOff) because the tag does not exist in the registry. The rollout exceeded progressDeadlineSeconds (30s) and is permanently stuck at ProgressDeadlineExceeded with 2 of 3 desired replicas unavailable.

_ground_truth.root_cause: Deployment revision 8 specified a non-existent image tag (rlvr/shipping:v99-nonexistent). All new pods are stuck in ImagePullBackOff/ErrImagePull because the registry returns 'manifest unknown'. The rollout exceeded progressDeadlineSeconds (30s) and is permanently wedged with ProgressDeadlineExceeded. The old-revision pod (v1.7.2) is still serving but at 1/3 capacity.
resolution_steps: Confirm the stuck rollout: kubectl rollout status deployment/shipping -n rlvr-target
Check image pull errors: kubectl describe pod shipping-7d9c4b6f88-q2m7x -n rlvr-target
Roll back to the working revision: kubectl rollout undo deployment/shipping -n rlvr-target
Verify: kubectl rollout status deployment/shipping -n rlvr-target (should show 3/3 replicas ready)
